long_biography.plain_text:
Raised near Baltimore after his family moved from Philadelphia, Stephen Bisciotti studied liberal arts at Salisbury State University and worked briefly in temporary staffing. At 23, he and cousin Jim Davis formed Aerotek from a modest basement office, initially supplying aerospace and technology companies with skilled temporary employees. That operation grew into Allegis Group, a global staffing and talent-management business.

Bisciotti used part of that founder-built fortune to enter professional football, purchasing a minority interest in the Baltimore Ravens in 2000 before completing majority control in 2004. His ownership tenure includes a Super Bowl championship and a long record of delegating football decisions to specialist executives. Allegis remains the origin of his wealth, while the Ravens have become both a major asset and his defining public role.
